title: Development web
description: A species' development web (#677): the nodes its dominated monsters develop along, in directions that portals and bridges connect. A node is open once a node next to it (along its direction, a bridge or a portal) is taken; every direction's first node is open from the start. One file per species, named after its id.

node_id.description: A node of this web: its direction's id, then its step along it from 1, e.g. sturdy_2.

shift.description: How much the node shifts the stat, in thousandths of the species' own (#33): 50 is +5%, -30 is -3%.

link.description: Two nodes it links, each next to the other from then on.

species.description: The species whose web it is, by id: the file's name.

directions.description: Its directions, in their order around the web: each sits beside the ones before and after it, the last beside the first.

id.description: Unique in its web: one lowercase word.

nodes.description: Its nodes, from the web's middle outward: each next to the one before it.

items.description: What taking it grants (#1404): exactly one of a stat leaning, a stronger special or a passive.

special.description: How much stronger it makes its species' special (#410), in thousandths of the special's power (#33): 200 is +20%.

passive.description: A passive it grants (#222), by its ability's id: one its species doesn't have, which no other node grants.

leaning.description: A stat leaning (#1358), raising some of the species' stats and maybe lowering others.

bridges.description: Bridges connect directions sideways: each links nodes of two directions side by side, at most one step apart.

portals.description: Portals connect one side of the web to the other: each links the outermost nodes of two directions.
